doc: Instance failure modes, merged after seed/autonomy/failure-modes.json by deploy/deploy-workers.mjs (COSTGUARD-1).

modes.failure: QNFO qnfo-audit D1 reads more than 15M rows per hour (or the sampler cannot measure it).
modes.root_cause: Full-table scans from qnfo-fleet-control, qnfo-ops and qnfo-fleet-dashboard (about 1750 rows read per query); the debounce trigger of QNFO/qnfo-workers PR 11618 must hold.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT rows_read_1h FROM cost_samples WHERE target='qnfo-audit' AND rows_read_1h IS NOT NULL AND at >= datetime('now','-3 hours') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) < 15000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: file the next fix against QNFO/qnfo-workers (account quniverse): index or LIMIT the heaviest scans, then raise the debounce.

fixes.title: QNFO/qnfo-workers: find the heaviest qnfo-audit queries (D1 insights by rows read per query) and add indexes or LIMITs to them.
QNFO/qnfo-workers: widen the debounce on qnfo-fleet-control, qnfo-ops and qnfo-fleet-dashboard readers of qnfo-audit (PR 11618 follow-up).
Bind CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN (read-only analytics on the quniverse account) to ultrastable-tick by code and set database_id in autonomy/cost-budgets.json, so the sampler can measure.
